mara (Design): quick one — noticed in dark theme the little status pill on the model cards (live / standby) is hard to read. screenshot -> https://img.redwood/test/xxxx :eyes: leo (Frontend): can you paste the exact card? is it the small rounded tag next to model name? mara (Design): yup, it's the 12px label. on 14px zoom it's basically unreadable. measured contrast ~2.8:1 between pill bg (#2b2b34) and text (#bdbdbd). WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for small text. leo (Frontend): ugh. current CSS: ```css .model-card .status { background: #2b2b34; color: #bdbdbd; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; } ``` leo (Frontend): quick idea: boost text to #ffffff or bump bg to #3f4450. either should help. prefer bg change to keep visual weight consistent. anya (A11y): agree on contrast. for 12px we need 4.5:1. #ffffff on #2b2b34 is about 7.2:1 so that's safe. bg #3f4450 with current text is ~4.6:1 (just making AA). If we pick the bg change, ensure states (hover/active/focus) maintain ratio. anya (A11y): other note: keyboard nav lands on card but the status pill is not in the tab order (fine) — but when you open the card flyout, focus jumps to the close x and not to the first interactive element. that creates a small focus trap when using VoiceOver. mara (Design): good catch. on our prototype the close x was first by accident. we intended primary CTA first. leo (Frontend): simple fix: set tabindex="-1" on the close button and move logical DOM order so the primary CTA is next. also add focus outline CSS we discussed earlier. sam (PM): what's the risk/time to ship? want to include in next console patch if small. leo (Frontend): contrast tweak + focus outline + DOM reorder = 2 dev hours + 1 QA hour. Regex for colours in theme variables and unit test to check contrast. anya (A11y): also need ARIA label tweak: screen reader currently reads "button" for the status pill when focused via switcher. add `aria-label="Model status: live"` or use `aria-hidden="true"` if it's purely decorative. For the flyout open announcement, add a polite live region: `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` with a short message "Opened settings for ". leo (Frontend): proposed snippet: ```html
Opened settings for {{modelName}}
``` leo (Frontend): and CSS for focus: ```css :focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.9); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 6px; } ``` anya (A11y): outline 3px with that color is fine for contrast. test on NVDA/Firefox and VoiceOver/Safari. Also check high-contrast and Windows Magnifier. ci-bot: accessibility-lint result: failed — model-card-contrast (severity: medium), flyout-focus-order (severity: low). Link: https://ci.redwood/a11y/2267890123 sam (PM): ok ship criteria: contrast >=4.5:1 for small text, flyout focus starts on primary CTA, SR announces "Opened settings for ". target in patch release this week? mara (Design): i'm happy with bg bump to #3f4450 if that keeps visual tone. leaving final color call to frontend after QA pass. :+1: leo (Frontend): i'll implement bg #3f4450, add aria-labels, reorder DOM, and push a small e2e plus accessibility tests. planning to open PR today. anya (A11y): i'll run quick NVDA/VoiceOver passes once the PR is up. ping me on the PR and i will add specific test steps. sam (PM): thanks — please add the PR link here when ready and tag me. leo (Frontend): will do. PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/7845 (WIP) ci-bot: deploy preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood/7845 (note: visual diff includes pill color change) anya (A11y): quick note for QA: also validate toast/live-region timing — when multiple flyouts open quickly the announcer should debounce to avoid spamming screen readers. mara (Design): noted. added to the card in Linear (#INFR-402). leo (Frontend): thanks all — closing loop once merged.
